text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
As the mighty All-Rounder, Agnes
Digital has
dominated her first three
years in the Twinkle
Series.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
There is nothing left for her to conquer,
yet her
gaze is locked on the top of a
ramp.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
A great sage once said that walking your
path
means being true to yourself...

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
I have climbed every ramp there is,
Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
But once you've reached the top, where
does that
path lead? After you finish
climbing, what comes
next?

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
A conventional answer. But take a look
at this
conundrum through the eyes of a
fanatic.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
Lower yourself as if in worship and, from
there,
follow the trajectory of the ramp.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I stoop down just as she asks and look
up the
ramp to find...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: The sky. The road up leads to the sky.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
Can you see it—the path I have yet to
conquer?

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
I'll cross the skies and take on the whole
world!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: And then...

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
So, you're really leaving. Good luck out
there,
Digital.

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Still, I'm astonished that you set your
sights on
running internationally. I hadn't
heard even a
whisper of such a grand
ambition before.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
Well, it's only natural I didn't mention it
before. I
mean, the idea just came to me.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
But I'm the All-Rounder! That means I
have to
conquer every racecourse there
is!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: That includes every racecourse around the world. In fact, I can't truly call myself that until I've won all around the world, can I?

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
Wow... Now that you mention it, that
makes
sense. You're incredible, Digital!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Anyone can see she's incredible at a
single
glance. ...But Agnes Digital herself
knows there's
an even bigger reason.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
But being the All-Rounder isn't the only
reason I
want to travel the world. I have
this... absurdly
intense feeling... that
cannot be contained...

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
What is this feeling? Whatever could it
be,
Trainer?!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
As her partner, I speak for her loud and
clear.

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: Whaaaat?! All the Umamusume... in the whole world?!

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Interesting. You've aggrandized
indulgence to its
most extreme heights.
So, that is the desire you
wish to sate?

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
That's right. All I want is to see cute
Umamusume
that are even stronger than
me!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
I wanna chase all of them, run by their
side, and
then connect with them! It's an
urge I can't
contain!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: That's why... I have to go!

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text:
I understand. In which case, I pray thee
go forth
hale and hearty. But know this...

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text:
There are many rulers abroad whose
strength
rivals that of even the
Overlord—the Trade Hawk
of Hong
Kong, and the Oil Tycoon of Dubai, to

name a few.

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text:
However versatile you may be, your
opponents
will have the home
advantage. Are you certain
you can win?

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
S-sure, racers abroad might be more
comfortable
on their home terrain...

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: But I'll have an advantage too!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
Because wherever I go, there'll be
precious Umas
waiting! So long as that's
true, there's no limit to
what I can do!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: And on top of that...

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: There's more?

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
Ah... Actually, the last bit's not
important. It
probably isn't worth
mentioning...

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
(On top of that, I have Opera O's,
Doto's, and
many other's blessings.)

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
(And I'll always have them to support
me.)

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
All right, Trainer—my partner in
crime—let's go!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
I'm gonna travel the world with my dear
comrade
in arms to see the things I love!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
It doesn't get more exhilarating than
this! If we
keep this up, then the world
will be our
all-you-can-simp buffet!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Agnes Digital sets off on her journey
with her
head held high and proud. As a
result...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Wooooo!

text_block_list.name: Caster
text_block_list.text:
Agnes Digital is in the lead! She's done
it! An
effortless victory in Hong Kong!
Her skill knows
no bounds!

text_block_list.name: Caster
text_block_list.text:
Agnes Digital snatches an overwhelming
victory
in Dubai, piercing through the
arid heat!

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: Opera O! Did you see Digital?

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Indeed. Her feats are truly astounding.
She's won
her way through country after
country without so
much as a glance
back home.

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text:
It appears there is no path ill-suited to
her.

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: You don't think she's tired?

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text:
She will not fall at the hands of
exhaustion.

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text:
For she is the All-Rounder, traveling the
world
with a love for Umamusume
unmatched by any.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Agnes Digital's passion is not bound by

international borders. Where her heart
leads, she
goes running.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Many racers have achieved victory
abroad, but
only the All-Rounder could
dash to and fro so
completely
unfettered.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
OOOOHOOHOO! PRAISE BE FOR

UMAMUSUMEEE!
